text: According to the book, the macroscopic thermodynamic arrow of time is explained by the CP violation (a small time-reversal asymmetry) observed in the weak nuclear force.
explanation: This is false. The book notes that although CP violation is a genuine but tiny time-reversal asymmetry detected in the decay of kaons and B-mesons, it plays no known role in the macroscopic asymmetries of thermodynamics, psychology, and cosmology. The leading account of the thermodynamic arrow appeals instead to entropy increase and the low-entropy Past Hypothesis.
